title: Renewal QBR + roadmap demo — two-part window & host coverage
text:
Renewal QBR + roadmap demo — two-part window & host coverage

['From: Emma Vargas <emma@clearwave.com>
To: monica_patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marco Diaz <marco.diaz@clearwave.com>, procurement@clearwave.com
Date: 2027-09-01 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal QBR + roadmap demo — availability and attendees

Hi Monica,

Hope you’re well. Our renewal is coming up and we need a focused QBR + roadmap demo to align internal stakeholders. We’re likely expanding use across two product teams, so preference is to split into: (A) 45-min executive/decision-maker overview and (B) 75-min technical deep dive for platform/infra.

Attendees: Marco (CTO), myself (Head of Product Ops), two SREs, procurement.

Availability windows next week (PST):
- Tue 9/7: 10–12, 15–17
- Wed 9/8: 09–11
- Thu 9/9: 13–16

Can you propose a two-part schedule and owners? Also need a sandbox access window for the SREs (read-only logs + KV-cache sample) before the deep dive.

Thanks — Emma

Emma Vargas
Head of Product Ops, ClearWave Health
', 'From: monica_patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Vargas <emma@clearwave.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Marco Diaz <marco.diaz@clearwave.com>, procurement@clearwave.com
Date: 2027-09-01 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR + roadmap demo — availability and attendees

Emma — thanks for the heads up and the attendee list. Proposal below to keep things actionable and limit ops overhead.

Proposed plan (two-part):
1) Exec overview (45 min) — Tue 9/7 10:30–11:15 PST 
   - Monica: product/roadmap highlights, renewal framing, commercial summary
   - Laura: success metrics and adoption health

2) Technical deep dive (75 min) — Wed 9/8 09:00–10:15 PST
   - Rishi: runtime architecture, warm-start strategy, failure-mode playbook
   - Rishi + SREs: sandbox walkthrough and KV/prefix caching demo

Pre-read & ops prep: we’ll provide a 30-min sandbox window Mon 9/6 14:00–14:30 PST with a short runbook (attached). Also attaching a draft mutual action plan and a concise agenda.

If you need to swap slots we can move the exec overview to Tue 9/7 15:00 and the deep dive to Thu 9/9 13:30.

Let us know final attendees so we can lock calendar invites and give SRE creds (read-only) for the sandbox.

— Monica
Monica Patel
Senior AM, Redwood Inference
', 'From: Marco Diaz <marco.diaz@clearwave.com>
To: monica_patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Vargas <emma@clearwave.com>, procurement@clearwave.com
Date: 2027-09-01 12:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR + roadmap demo — availability and attendees

Monica, this looks good. Two quick asks from my side: 
1) Can the deep dive include a 15-min section on data residency and KMS integration? We need to confirm audit posture before renewal sign-off.
2) Procurement would like an estimated timeline for contract redlines and a target by which they should expect final SOW.

Emma — we’ll aim to confirm on our side by EOD today.

— Marco
CTO, ClearWave Health
', 'From: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: marco.diaz@clearwave.com, emma@clearwave.com, monica@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, procurement@clearwave.com
Date: 2027-09-02 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR + roadmap demo — availability and attendees

Thanks Marco — we’ll add a 15-min KMS/data residency mini-block in the deep dive. A couple of ops notes before the sandbox window: 
- Sandbox access will be provisioned as read-only API keys scoped to a dedicated ClearWave sandbox project. Keys expire after 24 hours.
- The sandbox will include a small token sample and a KV cache dump (anonymized).
- Can you provide the preferred SREs’ email addresses so we can pre-authorize?

For procurement timeline: we can turn around a redline-friendly SOW within 3 business days after we receive your comment bundle. If you need a signed SOW before the QBR, we can accelerate but will need procurement confirmation by 9/3 COB.

Attachments: RW_Discovery_Runbook_v2.pdf (sandbox steps), MutualActionPlan_ClearWave-DL4821.xlsx

-rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
', 'From: Emma Vargas <emma@clearwave.com>
To: monica_patel <monica@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marco Diaz <marco.diaz@clearwave.com>, procurement@clearwave.com
Date: 2027-09-03 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR + roadmap demo — availability and attendees

Appreciate the quick follow-up. Confirming:
- Exec overview: Tue 9/7 10:30–11:15 PST (Monica + Laura) — attendees: Marco, Emma, Laura (ClearWave), two product directors (TBD).
- Technical deep dive: Wed 9/8 09:00–10:15 PST (Rishi + SRE block + KMS mini-block). SREs: j.santos@clearwave.com, a.lee@clearwave.com — please pre-authorize.
- Sandbox window accepted: Mon 9/6 14:00–14:30 PST — we’ll confirm exact SRE logins by 9/5 EOD.
- Procurement note: they’ll aim to get comments by 9/3 COB so Redwood’s 3-business-day turnaround is workable.

Please send calendar invites and the final agenda. Thanks — looking forward to it.

Emma
', '--Quoted original scheduling snippet (from Monica)
On Wed, Sep 1, 2027 at 11:05 AM Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Proposed plan (two-part):
> 1) Exec overview (45 min) — Tue 9/7 10:30–11:15 PST
> 2) Technical deep dive (75 min) — Wed 9/8 09:00–10:15 PST
> Pre-read & ops prep: sandbox Mon 9/6 14:00–14:30 PST (see attached runbook)
> -- End quote']
